questions.question: Who killed his seventy brothers and made himself king?
How did Abimelech die?
options: He was trampled by his fleeing soldiers
A woman dropped a millstone on his head
His own armor-bearer turned and killed him
He was struck down by an archer's arrow
questions.answer: A woman dropped a millstone on his head

questions.question: Jotham told a parable of the trees seeking a king to warn against Abimelech.
_____ killed his seventy brothers to seize power.
A woman dropped an upper _____ on Abimelech's head, crushing his skull.
